requires.label: must live in an Intermountain service area, unless the care was an emergency
requires.quote: Residency within an Intermountain service area for non-emergent hospital services

requires.label: may be denied for not applying for Medicaid or other programs
requires.quote: do not cooperate in applying for programs they may pay for their health care services such as Medicaid, may be denied financial assistance

rules.label: 100% off at or below 250% FPL, if uninsured or underinsured
rules.quote: Uninsured and Underinsured Patients with annualized family household incomes not in excess of 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines will be eligible for

rules.label: discount (Attachment B) above 250% up to 500% FPL, if uninsured or underinsured
rules.quote: incomes are in excess of 250% but less than or equal to 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines,

rules.label: medical hardship above 500% FPL: charges limited to 25% of income
rules.quote: Intermountain Health charges limited to 25% of their annual family income.

notes: Hand-written reference model. The free-care tier also requires all other payment options to be exhausted 'unless prohibited by local, state, or federal laws'; that condition is left out because Colorado law prohibits it for qualified patients.
The policy states no application window in days and no ECA waiting period in days.
